title: Apple Releases visionOS 27.2

content_html:
Monday October 26, 2026 10:46 am PDT by Juli Clover

Apple today released visionOS 27.2, the first big update for the visionOS 27 operating system that runs on the Apple Vision Pro.


visionOS 27.2 can be downloaded by opening the Settings app, selecting the General section, and choosing Software Update. Installing the update requires the headset to be removed, and a progress bar appears on the EyeSight display.

The visionOS 27.2 update provides bug fixes and security updates, per Apple's release notes.
